summary.classification_timing: batch wall time apportioned by fragment count

output_bins.TAXID_name: one species with at least the materialization threshold; original mates stay together
output_bins.species_other: species below the file-materialization threshold within this group; exact species retained in tables
output_bins.taxon_unresolved: valid higher-rank calls without a species; root means no unique taxonomic group
output_bins.unclassified: taxid 0, no retained taxonomic assignment; not a confidence grade

summary.pair_policy: both original mates share one final fragment/bin; host screen may evaluate mates independently
summary.reference_hits: Kraken taxonomic calls plus optional independent BWA-MEM2 human-host alignment
summary.taxonomy_policy: exact taxids remain in tables; higher-rank and true unclassified calls are separated; species below the materialization threshold may share physical FASTQ bins
summary.timing_note: batch wall time apportioned by fragment count
